context: Two cafe friends compare seaside trip ideas
purpose: Teach: ビニール/オート/懸賞/近辺/カーブ/貝/ニッポン/プロフェッショナル

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねえ、夏に海行きたいんだけど、東京近辺でおすすめある?
lines.en: Hey, I want to go to the sea this summer—any recommendations near Tokyo?
lines.style: Casual, warm, inviting tone between close friends chatting

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あ、それなら鎌倉とか江ノ島いいよ。海岸でビニールシート広げてのんびりするの最高。
lines.en: Oh, Kamakura or Enoshima would be great. Spreading out a vinyl sheet on the beach and relaxing is the best.
lines.style: Dreamy, soft, romantic delivery with gentle excitement

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね。でも私、運転苦手だから、オートマの車でも峠のカーブちょっと怖いんだよね。
lines.en: Nice. But I'm bad at driving—even with an automatic car, the curves on mountain passes scare me.
lines.style: Self-deprecating, light laughter, honest casual confession

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: じゃあ電車にしようよ。実は雑誌の懸賞で江ノ島の旅館ペア宿泊券、密かに狙ってるんだ。
lines.en: Then let's take the train. Actually, I'm secretly aiming for a prize draw pair stay at an Enoshima inn.
lines.style: Whispered confiding tone, playful and conspiratorial

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ええ、ロマンチストすぎ。ところで江ノ島って貝がら拾えるよね?姪っ子に持って帰りたい。
lines.en: Wow, such a romantic. By the way, you can collect seashells at Enoshima, right? I want to bring some back for my niece.
lines.style: Teasing affectionately, then shifting to fond family thought

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 拾えるよ。あと夏祭りでニッポン代表応援イベントもやるみたい。屋台も並ぶって。
lines.en: Yeah, you can. Also there's apparently a Team Nippon cheering event at the summer festival, with food stalls lined up.
lines.style: Informative, brightening, sharing happy travel discoveries

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 決まりだね。じゃあ来週、ガイドブック持ってきて。プロフェッショナルなプラン立てよう。
lines.en: It's decided then. Bring a guidebook next week, and let's make a professional plan.
lines.style: Decisive, cheerful, wrapping up with friendly resolve
